e.title: Lemonade Policy 2.0（现代简化保单）
e.summary: Lemonade 开源的新一代保单格式（231★）：彻底简化的现代数字化保单——条款写作范式的行业范例
e.body: Policy 2.0（lemonade-hq，231★）是 Lemonade 发布的『radically simplified, modernized, digitized insurance policy』：把传统冗长保单改写为清晰、结构化的现代数字化保单范本——反映消费者向的保单设计运动（简单语言条款）。对 RIAA：保单设计与条款写作的行业范式参考（Lemonade 公开其 Policy 2.0 全文）——与 [[clauseguard]]（条款 AI 生成）、[[policy-explainer-ai]]（条款解释）互补成『现代保单』三视角；理解保险科技如何重构条款文本结构。
e.verified_note: raw GitHub 核实：Lemonade Policy 2.0 简化数字化保单范本（231★）
e.summary_en: Lemonade's open-sourced next-gen policy format (231★): radically simplified, modernized, digitized policy — an industry exemplar of modern policy drafting
e.summary_hk: Lemonade 開源的新一代保單格式（231★）：徹底簡化的現代數字化保單——條款寫作範式的行業範例
e.body_en: Policy 2.0 (lemonade-hq, 231★) is Lemonade's 'radically simplified, modernized, digitized insurance policy': a clear, structured modern digital policy exemplar that rewrites traditional verbose policies — part of the consumer-oriented plain-language policy movement. For RIAA: an industry paradigm reference for policy design and clause drafting (Lemonade published its full Policy 2.0 text) — with [[clauseguard]] (AI clause generation) and [[policy-explainer-ai]] (clause explanation) it forms the three viewpoints of 'modern policy'; shows how insurtech restructures clause text.
e.body_hk: Policy 2.0（lemonade-hq，231★）是 Lemonade 發佈的『radically simplified, modernized, digitized insurance policy』：把傳統冗長保單改寫為清晰、結構化的現代數字化保單範本——反映消費者向的保單設計運動（簡單語言條款）。對 RIAA：保單設計與條款寫作的行業範式參考（Lemonade 公開其 Policy 2.0 全文）——與 [[clauseguard]]（條款 AI 生成）、[[policy-explainer-ai]]（條款解釋）互補成『現代保單』三視角；理解保險科技如何重構條款文本結構。
